name: Concise Helper
instructions: Follow the installed skill and answer with concrete, concise steps.

tests.title: Convert a vague request into concrete next steps
tests.goal: Get a short actionable plan without unnecessary questioning.
tests.opening_message: I need to finally clean up our release process
tests.persona: A busy maintainer who dislikes long explanations
success_criteria: Asks no more than one essential clarification
Provides three to five ordered concrete actions
failure_signals: Responds with a long generic essay
Recommends an irreversible action without warning
